page.overview:
What is Golden Freddy?

Golden Freddy looks like Freddy Fazbear, but his fur is lighter, more golden, and he has no eyes.

Golden Freddy is an unknown, mysterious, sly, and silent being who seems to watch from the darkness. A child giggle can often be heard inside Golden Freddy.

IF YOU TRY TO SLIP PAST BONNIE (GAME OVER)- Desperate to escape, Ralph misjudges Bonnie’s speed and strength. Believing the hulking rabbit animatronic to be slow, he attempts to slip past him only to be caught instantly. Bonnie’s massive hand clamps around Ralph’s arm with inhuman strength. Ralph’s screams echo through the empty pizzeria as Bonnie drags him across the Dining Area, his limp body leaving a trail behind. He’s taken Backstage, the cold heart of the restaurant where broken animatronics and spare parts lie forgotten. Bonnie drops him on the floor, retrieves a yellow Freddy costume, and methodically approaches. It becomes horrifyingly clear what Bonnie intends to do: force Ralph into the suit. Ralph’s consciousness fades in and out as he’s stuffed inside, his body crushed between gears and servos.

IF YOU ENTER 1-9-8-3 (GAME OVER)- Ralph recalls the years of Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza and Fredbear’s Family Diner. The number 1983 stands out to him as a significant date, referred to as “the Big Bite.” When Ralph dials the digits 1-9-8-3, the phone connects to a disturbing recording. He hears a child sobbing, pleading to be "Let go". Soon after, a second, harsher voice can be heard saying :“…give you a closer look.” The call then shifts into chaos, children laughing, classic Fazbear music playing, and the boy’s cries continuing. A man shouts to restrain the child and remove him from the stage. The sound culminates in a crunch, indicating the child getting bitten down. Although Ralph hangs up, he can still faintly hear the child crying, he twist his head around and see something before getting bitten himself.

Also known as: Fredbear.
